examples.question: What are some good tips for staying hydrated?
examples.answer:
Here are some tips for staying hydrated:
• Drink water regularly throughout the day
• Eat water-rich fruits like watermelon and oranges
• Keep a reusable water bottle with you
• Set reminders if you forget to drink

examples.question: How do I make scrambled eggs?
examples.answer:
To make scrambled eggs:
1. Crack 2-3 eggs into a bowl and whisk them
2. Heat butter in a pan over medium heat
3. Pour in the eggs and stir gently until cooked to your preference
